title: SAP PP Consultant
summary: SAP PP consultants set up and support the production planning part of SAP, which plans what a factory makes, when, and with which materials. They sit in an SAP project or support team and work with plant planners, the SAP MM team and developers.
dailyDuties: Configure MRP, BOMs, routings and work centers
Run workshops with plant planners on new processes
Write functional specs for reports and enhancements
Resolve support tickets on planning and production orders

skills.expectation: Configure MRP, BOMs, routings, work centers and production orders
Handle PP-MM integration for materials and stock
Gather planning requirements and write functional specs
Map as-is and to-be manufacturing processes
Plan and run integration and user acceptance tests
Work with plant, planning and finance teams
Train key users and explain design choices
Work with IDocs to MES and other systems
Write specs that ABAP developers can build from

certifications.why: The SAP certification that matches PP configuration work.
